title: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
description: The University of Ibadan Centre for Entrepreneurship and Innovation course: the foundations and theories of entrepreneurship, the entrepreneur and the Nigerian ecosystem, creativity, innovation and intellectual property, start-up business planning, ethics and social responsibility, legal issues, and digital business and contemporary entrepreneurship. Built from the ENT 211 module slides (Modules 1 to 9 and 12) and the course outline.

topics.title: Foundations and Theories of Entrepreneurship
topics.summary: Entrepreneurship has no single accepted definition. Cantillon saw the entrepreneur as a risk-bearer, Say as a coordinator of production, Schumpeter as an innovator driving creative destruction, and Drucker as someone who searches for change and exploits it. The course covers myths, types of entrepreneurship, the entrepreneurial process and economic, sociological, psychological and management perspectives.

topics.title: The Entrepreneur and Entrepreneurship Development in Nigeria
topics.summary: Entrepreneurs seek opportunities, take risks, mobilise resources and drive development. Their roles, characteristics, rewards and drivers, the entrepreneurial ecosystem and its components, and the history, challenges, prospects and support institutions of entrepreneurship in Nigeria are covered.
subtopics: Roles and functions of the entrepreneur
History and classification of Nigerian enterprises

topics.title: Creativity, Innovation and Intellectual Property
topics.summary: Creativity generates new ideas, innovation turns them into practical solutions, and entrepreneurship takes them to market. The module covers the creative process, techniques and barriers, types of innovation, innovation management and intellectual property.
subtopics: The seven-step creative process and techniques

topics.title: Start-up Business Planning
topics.summary: A business plan is a roadmap and formal document of a company's objectives and how it will achieve them. Planning is an ongoing process. The module covers the plan's components and preparation, business concept development, pitches and elevator pitches, business model design and the Business Model Canvas, the lean business plan and pitch decks.
subtopics: Business model canvas, lean plan and pitch deck

topics.title: Ethics and Social Responsibility
topics.summary: Ethics studies what is right and wrong in human behaviour. Entrepreneurs face ethical issues and dilemmas, which can be resolved with utilitarian, rights, justice and virtue approaches. Social responsibility applies ethics in practice through CSR, the 3Ps of people, planet and profit, and Carroll's pyramid.

topics.title: Legal Issues in Entrepreneurship
topics.summary: Business law governs business organisations and commercial transactions. Entrepreneurs must choose a business structure, protect intellectual property, use written contracts, follow employment, data protection, licensing and corporate governance rules, pay taxes, insure their business and understand the legal framework for start-ups in Nigeria.
subtopics: The Nigerian Start-up Act and incentives

topics.title: Digital Business and Contemporary Entrepreneurship
topics.summary: Contemporary entrepreneurship uses digital platforms, global reach, networks, mentors and leadership. Digital business uses technology, data and the internet across every part of an organisation, while e-commerce is buying and selling online. Digital marketing, social media strategy and online brand building complete the module.
subtopics: Networking, mentorship, role models and leadership
Social media strategy and online branding
